description: Defines Django ORM models for user management, courses, modules, lessons, enrollments, quizzes, questions, choices, quiz attempts, answers, certificates, learning paths, notifications, and audit logs in a learning management platform.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Custom user model supporting roles and additional profile fields.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Fine-grained permissions to complement role-based access.

classes.name: Course
classes.description: A course containing modules and lessons.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: A module belonging to a course.

classes.name: Lesson
classes.description: An individual lesson within a module.

classes.name: LessonProgress
classes.description: Track progress for a user on each lesson.

classes.name: Quiz
classes.description: Quiz associated with a lesson or a course.

classes.name: Answer
classes.description: Answers given within a quiz attempt.

classes.name: LearningPathItem
classes.description: An item within a learning path referencing a course with order.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object, typically its identifier or name.
